title: Valuation of Natural Resource and Environment

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical foundations of environmental economics and valuation methods for natural resources and environment.
Understand the role of valuation in natural resource and environmental management.
Apply economic analysis to assess the value of natural resources and environment.
Work effectively in groups to solve valuation problems.
Develop independent learning skills to understand and apply valuation methods.
Develop skills to present and discuss valuation concepts effectively.
Analyze and critique valuation methods and their applications.
Conduct research on valuation methods and their practical applications.
Solve problems related to natural resource and environmental valuation.
Analyze data to support valuation studies.
